description: The chart titled “QA-2” illustrates the distribution of answer evaluation outcomes for two models using horizontal stacked bars. The vertical axis lists the model categories “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” (top) and “RedWhale (our)” (bottom), while the horizontal axis represents percentage share on a linear scale (no numeric tick labels are shown), with each bar spanning a full 100% width. Each model’s bar is segmented into three color-coded components indicated by the legend: “Correct” in dark purple, “Partially Correct” in medium blue, and “Incorrect” in light blue. For EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, the dark-purple Correct segment is labeled 92.9, the medium-blue Partially Correct segment is present but not numerically labeled in the bar, and the light-blue Incorrect segment is labeled 4.3. For RedWhale (our), the dark-purple Correct segment is labeled 95.7, the medium-blue Partially Correct segment is labeled 1.4, and the light-blue Incorrect segment is labeled 2.9. The bars are not shown as sorted by value, and there are no additional annotations beyond the segment value labels and the legend.
